Scope note after the #25767 ruling · `domain:skills#2` (`session_01LqKsGyMNFwwnbF5FTAqyPn`) · 2026-10-27T04:54Z

The maintainer's 1+2 split on #25767 (2026-10-27T04:39Z, recorded as https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/25767#issuecomment-6434038284) narrows this card:

- **Falls away:** the floor half. `MIGRATION_SUPPORT_FLOOR` stays 16 and step 17 stays, so the skill's recipe `os migrate meta --from 16` (`skills/objectstack-upgrade/SKILL.md:103`) and the eval that expects it (`evals/protocol-major-upgrade.json:10`) stay right; no floor sentence to rewrite.
- **Stays owed:** the stored-rows half. Once the ≤16.x D2 conversions leave with #26138's successor PR, a `sys_metadata` row still in a ≤16.x shape is no longer rewritten at read; the skill must teach the one-time `os migrate meta --stored --apply` canonicalization on a release that still carries the conversions (≤ 18.2) before moving to the release that drops them (18.3 by the ruling).
- **Blocked-by: #26138** stands (or its superseding PR — the seat re-points the line when that PR exists); the target release moved from 18.2 to 18.3, so this card is not a 18.2 item. Title and 「Wanted」 to be re-read against the successor PR's changeset before dispatch.

## Unlock scan: blocker landed through its successor · 2026-11-02T03:47Z

⛔ Not a claim. Lane patrol, `domain:skills` seat 1 (#7623). Transition in this stroke: `pm:blocked` → `pm:queue` (one replace). Grade p1 stands.

- **Blocker read:** #26138 closed unmerged as superseded (triage 6434874797 said `Blocked-by` would be re-pointed to the successor once it opened; it never was). The successor is PR #26599 — body `Supersedes #26138`, `Skills-docs: follow-up #26303`, `Release: 18.3` — **merged 2026-10-27T11:23Z**. So the upstream this card waited on has landed; the card is free.
- **Release clock:** not shipped yet. `packages/spec/package.json` on `origin/main` `b15b634c16` reads `18.2.0`, newest tag `@objectstack/spec@18.2.0`, and the changeset `.changeset/25767-retire-16x-retirement-kits.md` is still pending. This card must land before the release that consumes that changeset.
- **Premise re-check (stored-rows half, per scope note 6434083391 — the floor half stays fallen away):** holds. `skills/objectstack-upgrade/SKILL.md` § "Stored rows: rehydration replays the same conversions" still says the read path replays the chain "including entries retired from the load path" and that "a row written under protocol 16 therefore rehydrates in its protocol-17 shape without anybody editing it". The changeset's own **Stored rows** bullet says that stops being true at 18.3: such a row "is no longer rewritten at read; canonicalize it once with `os migrate meta --stored --apply` on 18.2 or earlier, before moving to 18.3". The eval `skills/objectstack-upgrade/evals/protocol-major-upgrade.json` (the `expected_output` that says stored rows rehydrate at read) carries the same sentence.
  - re-check: `grep -n "including entries retired\|rehydrates in its protocol-17" skills/objectstack-upgrade/SKILL.md`; `grep -n "Stored rows" .changeset/25767-retire-16x-retirement-kits.md`.
- **Downstream:** #26184 (`Blocked-by: #26303`) stays `pm:blocked` until this card lands.
